newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Police arrest army deserter in Moscow, man wounded.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest army deserter in Moscow, man wounded.

text.p: Police said on Monday they had arrested an army deserter who wounded a man in Moscow while on the run.

A police spokesman said the soldier armed with a Kalashnikov assault rifle had escaped from his barracks in the Russian capital on Saturday night and wounded a pensioner in a block of flats near Kiev station just west of the city centre.
On Monday, police said they had found the man wearing civilian clothes among a group of homeless people sheltering in the attic of an apartment block in western Moscow, Russian media reported.

He no longer had the rifle and bullets he took from the barracks and police said they thought he may have given them away to his homeless companions, Interfax news agency said, quoting interior ministry official Alexander Shevchuk.
Police, who went on alert on Sunday, stopping cars and checking drivers' documents in central Moscow, were questioning the man before handing him over to military prosecutors.
